text:
You're not broke. You're still a boy living at home.

Your parents wash the dishes. Your parents pay the bills. Your parents absorb your mistakes.

Adulthood isn't a number. It's the moment your choices cost YOU. Just you.

Move out. Somewhere small. The moment you face your own trash, your own rent, your own failure alone, you meet yourself.

That's when you actually learn. Real consequences teach faster than any advice.

Your adulthood starts when you live it alone.
caption: Living at home past necessity keeps you dependent. Send this to a man who needs it today. #discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #adulthood #growthmindset
